newsitem.title: USA: MBIA qualifies eight muni issues for insurance.
newsitem.headline: MBIA qualifies eight muni issues for insurance.

text.p: MBIA Insurance Corp. said on Monday that it qualified for bond insurance the following eight issues scheduled for competitive sale:
--Scottsdale Pres Author, Ariz., tax and revenues, $20.5 million.
--Iowa Falls, Iowa, general obligation (GO) school bonds, $3 million.
--Johnson/Miami school district #229, Kan., GO school bonds, $34.21 million.
--Inver Grove Heights, Minn., $2.55 million tax increment GOs.
--South Seneca central school district, N.Y., GOs, $7.379 million.
